## Activity

During April 2026, North City Eye Clinic completed 550 captures. This represents the recorded imaging activity for the reporting period. The activity report provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the clinic’s service.

The results should be considered alongside the quality and grading measures below. Any operational concerns identified during routine work should be recorded through the usual reporting arrangements so they can be followed up appropriately.

## Image quality

There were 15 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 2.7 per cent. This measure indicates the proportion of completed captures that could not be used for grading. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk.

## Grading

A total of 157 results were graded referable during April 2026. The median grading lag was 2 days. This provides the reported midpoint for the time between capture and completion of grading.

The activity, image quality and grading figures should be retained for routine service monitoring at North City Eye Clinic. Any recurring issues affecting capture quality or grading times should be documented through the appropriate operational process.
